title: res.currency — Multi-Currency Rate Management and Conversion Chain

key_findings.rate_name_type: Date field (not string); unique per (name, currency_id, company_id)
key_findings.rounding_method: HALF-UP (away from zero) with epsilon IEEE-754 correction
key_findings.multi_company: rates always stored on root company; branches cannot create own rates
key_findings.THB_rounding: 0.01 standard (2 decimal places), active=False by default
key_findings.always_tax_exigible: True when not invoice and no cash-basis tax values pending

awt_items.description: Verify _get_rates SQL execution at runtime: confirm COALESCE fallback returns 1.0 when no rate is seeded for a currency, and that branch-company lookup correctly resolves to root-company rates
awt_items.reason: SQL subquery with dynamic SQL objects requires runtime verification to confirm correct rate row is selected under multi-company branch scenarios

function_ids: SCHEMA-CURRENCY-NAME: name Char(3) required unique ISO 4217
SCHEMA-CURRENCY-SYMBOL: symbol Char required; position before/after default=after
SCHEMA-CURRENCY-ROUNDING: rounding Float(12,6) default=0.01 constraint>0
SCHEMA-CURRENCY-DECIMAL-PLACES: decimal_places stored computed from rounding
FLOW-DECIMAL-PLACES-FORMULA: ceil(log10(1/rounding)) when 0<rounding<1 else 0
SCHEMA-RATE-NAME: name Date required indexed default=today unique(name,currency_id,company_id)
SCHEMA-RATE-VALUE: rate Float digits=0 'Technical Rate' constraint>0
SCHEMA-RATE-COMPANY: company_id M2O default=env.company.root_id nullable
GUARD-RATE-MAIN-COMPANY: ValidationError if company_id.parent_id set
FLOW-GET-RATES-QUERY: primary=latest<=date order by company_id,name DESC LIMIT 1
FLOW-GET-RATES-COALESCE: COALESCE(primary, fallback, 1.0)
FLOW-COMPUTE-CURRENT-RATE: rate=currency_rate/to_currency_rate; inverse=1/rate
FLOW-GET-CONVERSION-RATE: resolves root_id then reads inverse_rate via context
FLOW-CONVERT: from_amount * _get_conversion_rate; optional round(to_currency)
FLOW-ROUND: tools.float_round(amount, precision_rounding=rounding) HALF-UP
FLOW-FLOAT-ROUND-HALF-UP: epsilon=2**(log2(abs(v))-50) before round()
SCHEMA-CURRENCY-INVERSE-RATE: inverse_rate computed readonly Float digits=0
SCHEMA-RATE-COMPANY-RATE: company_rate computed/inversed user-facing display
FLOW-MULTI-COMPANY-ROOT: company always resolved to root_id before rate lookup
CONFIG-THB-ROUNDING: THB rounding=0.01 active=False symbol=฿
FLOW-TOGGLE-MULTI-CURRENCY: group_multi_currency auto on/off by active count
FLOW-VIEW-RATE-LABELS: _get_view relabels rate columns with company currency name
SCHEMA-ACCOUNT-MOVE-CURRENCY: currency_id required computed priority chain
CONFIG-EXCHANGE-JOURNAL: currency_exchange_journal_id type=general on res.company
FLOW-ALWAYS-TAX-EXIGIBLE: True when not invoice and no cash-basis tax values
